CWL 571 explores time, memory, and perception as these concepts were formulated in the early 20th century by literary authors, scientists, and theoreticians from Russia, Germany, France, and Britain. The writers to be examined include Henri Bergson, Sigmund Freud, Walter Benjamin, Virginia Woolf, David Bergelson, and Osip Mandelshtam. No knowledge of Russian required.
